headline: Environmental Officer
summary: Environmental officer with eleven years in forest, coastal and farm conservation in Negros Oriental. I lead programs on forest management, waste, biodiversity and conservation farming, make sure projects comply with environmental laws, and help local governments write their environmental policies. I manage a team of eight.

experience.title: Environmental Officer
experience.employer: Negros Oriental Environment and Livelihood Foundation
experience.paragraph: Lead a team of eight on conservation programs in the mountain and coastal towns of Negros Oriental.
bullets: Designed a community forest management plan covering 3,500 hectares, now part of the provincial land-use plan.
Run solid waste and composting programs with 14 barangays, cutting waste to the dump by a third.
Check projects against environmental laws and prepare compliance reports for regulators.
Help towns draft ordinances on tree cutting, quarrying and waste.

experience.title: Conservation Program Officer
experience.paragraph: Worked on biodiversity and conservation farming projects around the strait.
bullets: Trained upland farmers in conservation agriculture and agroforestry.
Organised mangrove and forest planting with communities and schools.
